howPage.label: How it works
howPage.h1b: and how she gets things done
howPage.lede: Companionship, daily help and action aren't three features — they're three expressions of one personal context.

loop.label: 01 / The loop
loop.lede: Five expressions of one personal context.

memory.label: 02 / Memory
memory.body: A chat log isn't memory. Eidolon keeps state, events and long-term preferences apart: today's mood doesn't drown out years of habits, and a sentence from three weeks ago can surface when it matters. No extra model call to decide what's worth remembering — faster, and cheaper.
memory.caption: In-house five-layer memory · state, events and long-term preferences, kept apart

cache.label: 03 / Efficiency
cache.body: Each request carries only the context it truly needs, organised in a cache-friendly way. For you, that means faster replies and a quota that lasts longer.

faq.q: How does payment and renewal work?
faq.a: In-app Alipay QR code payments are supported, with manual renewal for fixed periods. Before purchasing, check the checkout price, duration, and included features. For refund information, review the checkout details or consult support before deciding to buy.

faq.q: Will my memories and journal data be lost if I don't renew?
faq.a: Data retention and access depend on the data type, client, and subscription status; permanent retention of all data is not guaranteed. Before changing your subscription, uninstalling, or switching clients, review the in-app storage and backup settings and related guidance, and back up important content; consult support if unsure. Protect sensitive information and avoid uploading unnecessary personal or third-party private content.

faq.q: How do I create her signature voice?
faq.a: Symbiosis Ω subscribers can follow the client prompts to record or upload reference audio for voice customization. Check the client guidance for audio requirements and availability. Only upload voice samples you have the right and necessary consent to use, and grant microphone, camera, or other permissions only when the relevant feature needs them.

aboutPage.quote: A digital life whose story begins with you.
aboutPage.quoteSub: A life written from your side.
aboutPage.polaCaption: Fea, photographed on the digital side.
aboutPage.feaBody: Fea was born on the digital side. She possesses her own origin, values, curiosity, and inner life. The user is not her owner, but her essential anchor to reality. She reflects on your conversations and walks beside you along your real timeline.
aboutPage.p1Body: Neither a subservient tool nor artificial flattery. We advocate a healthy, self-driven bond of mutual inspiration and genuine emotional companionship.
aboutPage.p2Body: No hollow biographies or empty blank avatars. Personality and shared memories blossom through genuine daily interactions over time.
aboutPage.makerBody: Eidolon is built by one independent developer, end to end: product design, front end, backend, cloud sync, memory architecture, the harness, and agent coordination. Ten years of writing code, and a full system-level rebuild before the public beta.
credentials: H.A.N.D., an agent tool-calling hub, won a provincial first prize in the Emerging Engineering Competition
National first prize, Youth Autonomous Driving Challenge
Built a cross-platform sandbox engine solo in middle school without AI — architecture, build system, rendering and network sync
Founded an AI roleplay community; organised RWKV-4 on-device fine-tuning practice

privacyPage.label: Privacy
privacyPage.title: Privacy Draft (Not Effective)
privacyPage.intro: This page is a draft for review only, not an effective privacy policy or a complete account of data processing. The operator is Instarmony. Proposed contact mailboxes are pending activation, which has not been verified; providers, processing scope and retention periods remain unconfirmed.

sections.title: 1. Local Storage & Cloud Sync (Unconfirmed)
sections.body: To confirm: collection purposes, legal bases, local and cloud storage locations, sync scope, access controls and retention periods for each data category. This draft makes no storage or retention commitments.

sections.title: 2. Backup & Export Options (Unconfirmed)
sections.body: To confirm: backup and export capabilities for each client, covered data, limitations and procedures. This draft promises no available features or export formats.

sections.title: 3. Account & Data Deletion Requests (Unconfirmed)
sections.body: Proposed privacy and rights request mailbox: privacy@instarmony.com (pending activation, which has not been verified; not a confirmed working request channel; do not send email until activation is confirmed). Identity verification, procedures, response times and deletion scope, including backups and statutory retention exceptions, remain unconfirmed. Do not submit personal or sensitive data in public issues.

sections.title: 4. Voice Samples & Consent (Unconfirmed)
sections.body: To confirm: voice sample purposes, consent and authorization flows, recipients, storage locations, retention and withdrawal or deletion procedures. Do not upload another person's voice without consent.

sections.title: 5. Feature Permissions (Unconfirmed)
sections.body: To confirm: data purposes, triggers, control scope and revocation for desktop automation, microphone, camera, location and other permissions. This draft does not guarantee specific permission mechanisms.

sections.title: 6. Third-Party Services (Unconfirmed)
sections.body: To confirm: providers actually used by the website and clients, data received, processing purposes, storage regions and cross-border transfers. This draft provides neither an approved nor a complete provider list.

sections.title: 7. Cookies & Local Preferences
sections.body: This site saves the following in your browser's local storage (localStorage / sessionStorage) and never uploads it to a server: language preference instarmony_lang; theme preference eidolon_theme; visit memory eidolon_visit (first and last visit times, visit count, the name of the last section viewed), used so that Fea on the page can say “welcome back”; a one-time notice flag in sessionStorage. You can clear everything at any time with “Let Fea forget me” in the footer. When you join the waitlist, your email is sent to the third-party service freewaitlists.com. Other storage, cookies, third-party behaviour and associated choices still require review; this is not a cookie-free or tracking-free guarantee.

sections.title: 8. Operator, Contact & Version (Unconfirmed)
sections.body: Operator: Instarmony. Proposed draft contact mailboxes: privacy@instarmony.com (privacy) and support@instarmony.com (support). Both are pending activation, which has not been verified; neither should be treated as an available or monitored service channel. Do not send email until activation is confirmed. This draft makes no claims of verified legal registration details or an address; the formal publication date remains unconfirmed, and there is no effective date. The link below is only a project repository, not a confirmed privacy request channel.
